actions.create_application.props.default: Priority (0-10) used for messages sent without one.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a request to any Gotify API endpoint with the Client Token.
actions.custom_api_call.props.path.descr: Endpoint path on your Gotify server, for example /message or /application/1.
actions.delete_application.description: Delete an application and all of its messages.
actions.delete_application_messages.desc: Delete all messages of one application.
actions.delete_application_messages.prop: Numeric ID of the application whose messages are deleted.
actions.delete_message.description: Delete one message by its ID.
actions.delete_message.props.messageId.d: Numeric ID of the message to delete.
actions.get_current_user.description: Get the Gotify user of the Client Token.
actions.get_server_health.description: Get the health and version of the Gotify server.
actions.list_applications.description: List the applications of the connected Gotify user.
actions.list_clients.description: List the clients (devices) of the connected Gotify user.
actions.list_messages.description: List messages, newest first, optionally for one application.
actions.list_messages.props.applicationI: Only list messages of this application. Empty = all.
actions.list_messages.props.limit.descri: Maximum number of messages to return (1-200). Default 100.
actions.list_messages.props.since.descri: Only messages with a lower ID (nextSince of the previous page).
actions.send_notification.description: Send a push notification through your Gotify server.
actions.send_notification.props.big_imag: Image shown in the expanded notification on Android (http or https).
actions.send_notification.props.click_ur: URL opened when the notification is tapped (http or https).
actions.send_notification.props.markdown: Ask Gotify clients to render the message as Markdown.
actions.send_notification.props.priority: 0 (lowest) to 10. Empty uses the application default.
actions.update_application.description: Change the name, description or default priority of an application. Gotify replaces all three fields on every update, so fields you leave empty are re-sent with the values read just before the update; do not run two updates of the same application at the same time.
auth.description:
To connect Gotify:

    1. Log in to your Gotify web UI.
    2. Open **Apps**, create an application (or pick one) and copy its token into **App Token**. It is used to send notifications.
    3. Optional: open **Clients**, create a client and copy its token into **Client Token**. It is needed to read and delete messages and to manage applications.
auth.props.app_token.description: Token of a Gotify application. Used to send notifications.
auth.props.base_url.description: The address of your Gotify server, e.g. https://gotify.example.com
auth.props.client_token.description: Token of a Gotify client. Needed to read or delete messages and manage applications.
